[[File:LottDod-FF139.png|thumb|right|150px|Lott Dod, wearing his supreme representative mantle]]
A '''supreme representative mantle''' was a type of mantle worn by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], symbolizing his position as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
